»»————-　♡　————-««[/color][/center][center][color=#dbb0a7]
[font=Times New Roman]This mod adds 17 new tasty candy recipes to the game, all from the indie mobile game Candies 'n Curses! They are all very easy to make, but hard to obtain. Almost all of them give the player some kind of buff (or multiple ones), and the remaining ones have insane amounts of healing.[/font]


[/color][color=#f4cccc]⚝──⭒─⭑─⭒──⚝

[/color][font=Times New Roman][color=#dbb0a7]The recipes are:[/color]

[/font][color=#f4cccc][font=Times New Roman]Battery Bonbon
Butter Pop
Butterfly Sugar
Chocolate Mousse
Chocolate Shell
Cloak Gumdrop
Dragon Scale Yum Pop
Grandma's Favorite Cookie
Gross Feet Chew
Halo Bar
Heart-shaped Lollipop
Jab Breaker
Moonlit Bubblegum
Soul Taffy
Spirit Fudge
Sugar Heart
Zappy Taffy[/font]

⚝──⭒─⭑─⭒──⚝[/color][/center]
[color=#dbb0a7][font=Times New Roman]Here's how you get them:[/font]
[/color][spoiler]All of the recipes are purchasable from Krobus after year 2.[/spoiler]


[i][font=Times New Roman][color=#dbb0a7][b]All of the sprites were made by me based on the original candies in Candies 'n Curses.[/b][/color][/font][/i]
